description: ADA / WCAG Lawsuit Shield & DOM Auto-Patcher — Returns a FAIL / REVIEW / PASS verdict for a page's HTML (pasted or fetched from a URL) against the WCAG failures most cited in ADA demand letters: alt text, form labels, unnamed buttons and links, lang, headings, landmarks, skip links, zoom. Each issue carries a CSS selector, source line and fix, with a top-five list, a SARIF 2.1.0 log, a litigation risk score, per-element patched HTML and an int

url.description: Page to audit. Provide url or html.
